patterns.note: A dense, asymmetrical collage layout where graphic elements, text blocks, and images are layered and overlap, mimicking torn paper and hand-drawn illustrations on a dark background.
Prominent use of distressed, heavy, uppercase display fonts for section headings, contrasted with smaller, clean sans-serifs for body text and informal, handwritten-style annotations.
A stark, high-contrast monochromatic palette primarily using black and white, with subtle dark grey tones for depth and texture.

A multi-layered parallax scrolling effect where various background illustrations and torn paper elements move at slower, independent rates compared to the foreground content, creating a sense of depth and dynamism. The main logo and menu button remain sticky at the top.

Sections are not defined by distinct full-width containers but rather by large, expressive typographic headings and clusters of thematically related, often overlapping, graphic elements and content snippets.

technique_notes: Implement a sticky header for the main logo and navigation menu to maintain persistent access. Create a multi-layered parallax scrolling system where background illustrative elements are positioned at different Z-depths and scroll at varying, slower speeds compared to the main content blocks, giving a sense of depth. This can be enhanced with canvas or Lottie animations for specific background elements. Achieve the overall aesthetic through custom, gritty, hand-drawn illustrations, torn paper textures, and distressed typography, all rendered in a high-contrast black and white color scheme.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, condensed, distressed headings (~4-5x body text) with a strong visual presence, complemented by smaller, clean sans-serif body text and tiny, informal handwritten annotations.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are prevalent, especially on torn paper elements and image cutouts, contributing to a raw and unpolished aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Dense and intentionally overlapping, creating a dynamic, collage-like composition where elements are tightly packed and interact visually, with minimal clear negative space.

standout: The site's distinctive, raw, and highly stylized collage aesthetic, combining hand-drawn illustrations, distressed typography, and torn paper textures in a monochromatic palette, creates a unique and memorable brand identity that feels like a digital punk zine.
